title: b10x-protocol-catalog/1
description: A b10x-protocol-catalog/1 document: the manifest of the engineering protocol catalog, protocols/manifest.yaml. It lists every file under protocols/ but the manifest itself, each with the sha256 of its bytes, so a consumer checks a file it took from a tag against the manifest of that tag without compiling anything from this repository. The repository's tests (crates/canon-engineering/tests/catalog_manifest.rs) refuse a manifest that names another schema or one that does not exist, leaves out a file under protocols/, names a file that does not exist, lists a digest, id or revision the file does not have, lists a canon release above the Canon pinned in Cargo.lock, or has a field this schema does not name.

schema.description: The path of this schema relative to the repository root, so a reader of the manifest alone can find the rules it follows: always schema/b10x.protocol-catalog.v1.schema.json, in the same tag as the manifest.

vocabulary.description: The engineering vocabulary, the one catalog file that is not a protocol.

path.description: The vocabulary file relative to the repository root, always protocols/vocabulary.yaml.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes as they are in the repository, in lowercase hexadecimal.

protocols.description: One entry per protocol file, protocols/<name>/<major>.yaml.

path.description: The protocol file relative to the repository root, protocols/<name>/<major>.yaml under the rule crates/canon-engineering/build.rs embeds built-ins by. No path is listed twice.

id.description: The protocol id Canon parses from the file's protocol.id, such as software.change.

revision.description: The revision Canon parses from the file's protocol.revision.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes as they are in the repository, in lowercase hexadecimal.

canon.description: The lowest Canon release, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, that parses, validates and compiles the file. Canon has no field for it: the value is declared here by hand, from the newest protocol/1 form the file uses. The repository's check only refuses a Canon pinned in Cargo.lock that is lower than this value; a value lower than the release the file really needs is not detected, and a Canon older than that refuses the file with a parse or validation error, not a version message.
